title: Honeyed Italian Butter Cacio E Pepe
description: Buttery, gooey, and energizing, this Italian classic features Asian-chive-buchu and no onions or garlic.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over low heat.
Add the honey and black peppercorns to the melted butter and stir until well combined.
Add the Asian chive buchu to the honey mixture and stir for 1 minute.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the cacio e pepe pasta according to the package instructions.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the heavy cream and eggs until well combined.
Add the parmesan cheese to the cream mixture and stir until smooth.
Add the cooked pasta to the cream mixture and toss until well coated.
Add the honey mixture to the pasta and toss until well combined.
Stir in the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter until melted and smooth.
Season the pasta with salt to taste.
Serve the pasta hot and enjoy!
